name: NOVA POSHTA ANCHORED RESULTS UX FIX
changes: Replaces the oversized mobile bottom sheet with a compact result panel anchored to the active city or warehouse field
Fits the panel into Safari visualViewport above the keyboard and browser controls, placing it above the field when needed
Keeps the form and active field visible instead of covering most of checkout
Resets result scroll position after every search so the first match is never clipped
Ranks an exact Nova Poshta warehouse number first when the customer enters digits
Closes the mobile keyboard after selecting a city or warehouse
Preserves cached search, request cancellation, courier delivery and single-warehouse autoselect
Bumped live assets and PWA cache to RC26
